To: d.kerrigan@northmail.example
Replying to: m01
Cc: none
Subject: Re: Blister packs for my mother - new patient

Dear Mr Kerrigan,

Thank you for contacting us about your mother’s medications. We would be pleased to welcome Margaret to Erindale Park Pharmacy and help make her return home easier for both of you.

We prepare weekly blister packs containing seven days of medication, with four dosing times each day. There is currently no charge for the packaging itself. Regular prescription charges still apply; Ontario Drug Benefit covers most eligible medication costs for patients aged 65 and over, although co-payments or other charges may apply. We can confirm these once we have her prescriptions.

We can deliver to your mother’s building on Mississauga Valley Boulevard. Our regular delivery days are Tuesdays and Fridays, between 2 and 6 p.m., with free delivery within eight kilometres. For her first packs, we can arrange a one-off Saturday delivery before 1 p.m., or you are welcome to collect them. Please let us know which you would prefer.

To arrange the prescription transfer, please provide her current pharmacy’s name and address. We will also need her OHIP number, which you can give us by telephone rather than ordinary email. We will contact her current pharmacy directly; she does not need to sign a transfer form.

The first packs take approximately 48 hours to prepare after we have received all her prescriptions, including the hospital discharge prescriptions and those transferred from her current pharmacy. Please ask the hospital to fax the discharge prescriptions to us early Thursday morning. We would then aim to have the packs ready Saturday, provided all the necessary information has arrived and any medication questions have been resolved.

The first blister packs will not be ready when she leaves hospital on Thursday. Before discharge, please confirm with the discharge team that she will have an interim medication supply and that someone will help her with every dose until the packs are collected or delivered on Saturday. Please let us know if there is any difficulty arranging this so we can coordinate with the team.

I would be happy to go through her medication list with you once we have Margaret’s permission. To protect her privacy, our pharmacy records this on a Family Communication Consent form, which she needs to sign before we discuss her medications with you. She can sign it at pickup, or we can send it with the delivery driver.

I would also like to offer Margaret a MedsCheck at home during her first week back. This is an approximately 20-minute medication review. I can visit Monday or Tuesday after 6 p.m.; please let me know whether either evening would suit her and whether she would like you to join us.

My direct number is 905-555-0148 ext. 2. I am in the store Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.

Kind regards,

Rania Haddad
Community Pharmacist
Erindale Park Pharmacy
